answer: What survives to the bridge is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The basalt is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sable.
